ops.title: ccx-merged-branch handoff: stale merged PR binding fix
ops.body:
Lane ccx-merged-branch (meta-desk-3, drive durable-agents-rebuild). Brief: /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/meta-desk-3/b/ccx-merged-branch.md. Repo yasyf/cc-context.

State at 5:05 PM Nov 6: fix written, built, vetted and linted (0 issues) in worktree /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-context/ccx-merged-branch (branch ccx-merged-branch off origin/main 36ef4146). Not yet committed or shipped.

Defect: stackQueryPRs (internal/cli/stackprs.go) takes the newest PR of any state by head name; a branch reusing a long-merged PR's name (release-simplify-2, #30312) bound to it and stackSnapshot failed on its missing head.

Fix: stackReusedName drops a CLOSED or MERGED read whose head differs from refs/heads/<branch> when the head is missing locally (cat-file -e, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1), or present with no ancestry either way and no shared authored commit ("%an <%ae> %at") between `tip --not --remotes=*/<trunk>` and `head --not --remotes=*/<trunk>`. A branch absent locally, an OPEN PR or an empty head keeps today's binding.

Deviation from brief: the brief's literal rule (head not an ancestor of tip unbinds) would drop real landings ccx detects today: a branch behind its landed head, a head the merge queue or a mid-run rebase replayed (975fc8f1, 9df64e29), a child the queue replayed onto its parent's squash. The shared-authored-commit test keeps those. Codex finder (sol) raised 5 majors on the first version (strict containment, origin/<trunk> pin); the intersection plus --remotes=*/<trunk> answers 1, 2, 3 and 5; 4 (shallow boundary hiding ancestry) is accepted: a lane's own commits sit above its shallow root.

Not covered: `ccx vcs status` and `vcs info` keep their own newest-by-head queries; their tests replay recorded real SHAs absent from fixtures, so the same filter there would break them. A missing head that a partial clone could lazily fetch now reads as no PR instead of being fetched.

Test: TestStackQueryPRsLeavesOutAnEarlierBranchsPullRequest in internal/cli/stackprs_test.go (merged at tip binds; never-fetched head drops; closed earlier-branch head drops; replayed head binds). CHANGELOG Fixed entry added.

Next: ccx vcs ship with PR body, merge with `ccx vcs merge <n> -R yasyf/cc-context --admin --match-head-commit <sha>`, then cci landed --pr, SendMessage team-lead with PR and merge sha, then cci done. Never install.
